learning_objectives: Understand x as the counterclockwise arc length on the unit circle and as the horizontal coordinate of the sine graph
Compare the identical signed vertical coordinates in the unit circle and at (x, sin(x))
Observe the progressive sine graph from x=0 to x=4*pi, with exact pi/2 axis ticks
Change angular speed between 5 and 120 degrees per second without changing the current angle
Interpret one complete revolution as arc length 2*pi and recognize the second period; its remaining orange arc is labelled x-2*pi
Use pause, reset, arc-length selection and exact-angle shortcuts to compare both green bars from y=0 to y=sin(x); restored work opens paused
